source: Phase 0.5 local PostgreSQL baseline and two Phase 3.2 after snapshots
fixture: phase-0.5-synthetic-v1 on local PostgreSQL 17; 5 friends, 5 outgoing requests, 5 incoming requests, 15 unrelated searchable users, 1 blocked candidate

method.handler: current GET Route Handler with real Prisma/PostgreSQL; only authentication mocked
method.timings: Median milliseconds. DB proxy is the sum of node-postgres round trips, not aggregate PostgreSQL execution time. Handler wall excludes HTTP transport.
method.rowsReturnedBySql: Sum of SQL rowCount values, not rows scanned.

queryFlow.before: Three candidate/profile/stats queries, then 30 friendship reads and 45 conditional request reads for 30 candidates.
queryFlow.after: Three unchanged candidate/profile/stats queries, one friendship query and one friend-request query scoped to viewer and candidate IDs.

explainAnalyzeAfter.batchedFriendRequests: Bitmap heap scan over two existing compound-index branches; 10 actual rows, one loop, 0.053 ms representative execution.
explainAnalyzeAfter.batchedFriendships: Bitmap heap scan over two existing compound-index branches; 5 actual rows, one loop, 0.046 ms representative execution.
explainAnalyzeAfter.note: Read-only local plans only; no index change.

result: CONFIRMED IMPROVEMENT: broad search drops from 78 to 5 SQL queries; both five-result and 30-result searches use two relationship queries. SQL row totals, result counts, status mix, and payload bytes remain stable.
